title: statusline r17 UX: human broken-state per-kind recovery understated at the requirement
description: Round 17. Lens: ux, low severity (validator: DR). Defect: the criterion demands per-kind human recovery from the shared data, but the requirement frames the data as machine members only and the human form as bare diagnostic — implementers building to the requirement under-provision the data. Citations verified: contract:163 vs :188. Proposed: resolved-candidate (requirement states the human recovery is per-kind and the data carries machine members and human text both).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: the requirement states the human form's per-kind named recovery, with one kind-keyed data set carrying both surfaces' members — machine tokens and human text alike. Revision: Status bullet.
